018package org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc;
019
020import static java.lang.String.join;
021import static javax.tools.Diagnostic.Kind.ERROR;
022import static org.apiguardian.api.API.Status.STABLE;
023import static org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.ToolKit.EMPTY_STRING;
024import static org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.ToolKit.NOT_FOUND;
025import static org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.ToolKit.first;
026
027import javax.lang.model.element.Element;
028import java.util.ArrayList;
029import java.util.List;
030
031import org.apiguardian.api.API;
032import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.CustomTagletBase;
033import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.foundation.annotation.ClassVersion;
034import com.sun.source.doctree.DocTree;
035import com.sun.source.doctree.UnknownInlineTagTree;
036
037/**
038 *  <p>{@summary This inline tag inserts an image reference to the
039 *  documentation.} It can be used as this:</p>
040 *  <pre><code>&hellip; {&#64;image &lt;<i>url</i>&gt; &lt;<i>attributes</i>&gt;} &hellip;</code></pre>
041 *  <p>The URL points to the picture, and &lt;text&gt; contains addition
042 *  attributes that will be added to the {@code <img>} tag.</p>
043 *  <p>The {@code {@docRoot}} is supported for the URL.</p>
044 *
045 *  @author Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
046 *  @version $Id: ImageTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $
047 *  @since 0.25.2
048 */
049@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: ImageTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $" )
050@API( status = STABLE, since = "0.25.2" )
051public final class ImageTaglet extends CustomTagletBase
052{
053        /*-----------*\
054    ====** Constants **========================================================
055        \*-----------*/
056    /**
057     *  <p>{@summary The name of this taglet: {@value}.}</p>
058     */
059    public static final String TAGLET_NAME = "image";
060
061        /*--------------*\
062    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
063        \*--------------*/
064    /**
065     *  <p>{@summary Creates a new {@code ImageTaglet} instance.}</p>
066     */
067    public ImageTaglet()
068    {
069        super( TAGLET_NAME, true, Location.values() );
070    }   //  ImageTaglet()
071
072        /*---------*\
073    ====** Methods **==========================================================
074        \*---------*/
075    /**
076     *  {@inheritDoc}
077     */
078    @Override
079    public final String toString( final List<? extends DocTree> tags, final Element element )
080    {
081        final List<String> buffer = new ArrayList<>();
082        for( final var tag : tags )
083        {
084            if( tag instanceof UnknownInlineTagTree inlineTagTree )
085            {
086                final var arguments = processTagContent( inlineTagTree.getContent(), element );
087                final var pos = arguments.indexOf( ' ' );
088                if( pos == NOT_FOUND )
089                {
090                    buffer.add( "<img src=\"%s\">".formatted( processTagContent( parseText( arguments ), element ) ) );
091                }
092                else
093                {
094                    final var url = processTagContent( parseText( arguments.substring( 0, pos ) ), element );
095                    final var attributes = arguments.substring( pos + 1 );
096                    buffer.add( "<img src=\"%1$s\" %2$s>".formatted( url, attributes ) );
097                }
098            }
099            else
100            {
101                printf( ERROR, "Cannot process tag of '%s' (class '%s'): %s", tag.getKind().name(), tag.getClass().getName(), first( 20, tag.toString() ) );
102            }
103        }
104        final var retValue = join( EMPTY_STRING, buffer );
105
106        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
107        return retValue;
108    }   //  toString()
109}
110//  class ImageTaglet
111
